cold: #197's cold test: written before the pose, from the sources alone. Don't read it while posing this lift, and tune neither to the other.
sources: No library video. Searched reference: NASM's eTCBSFlCJ_s, so weaker than the others
docs/research/grip.md: a rope, mid-palm, the fist just above the end stop

lines.says: the arms go from near straight to well bent
at the pulled end the elbows stand about shoulder height or above
at the pulled end the hands are up by the head
the hands make a real pull
the trunk stays still: no leaning back to pull
at the pulled end the forearms stand up, the fists beside the ears, the elbows out wide
the rope comes to the face and parts around it, not to the chest or the neck
at the long end the arms reach up toward a pulley at about head height or above
